title: raft_heatmap QGIS plugin
description: Plugin that streamlines custom heatmap generation for SDRPF River Assessment Field Team (RAFT) data. The plugin allows a user to select a CSV export from the RAFT program, filter data pins by category, and visualize pins as a heatmap. Ideal for generating maps of activity hotpots for presentations and as a starting point for further analysis. This project also serves as an example of QGIS plugin development for future RAFT interns.
duties: Technology: Python, QGIS Plugin templater, QML, PyQt, Sphinx
See the Project Documentation for additional installation, usage, and development information
